name: The Five Trials
description: Trials on the path to the afterlife, established by the God-Pharaoh to purify and perfect the people; each cultivates an aspect of mortal perfection.

timeline.summary: Each god oversees one of the five trials and instructs the initiates preparing to face it.
timeline.quote: Each god oversees one of the five trials and instructs the initiates who are preparing to face the trial
